headline: As of 2026-10-27: 31,994,709 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+11.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 31,994,709 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,906,897), California (3,276,574), Florida (3,152,882).
